label: original-phase input of h/0/y/f/r/1/g/x from step 3 on
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, never at t<2 or on the delimiter/copy phase. Firing rate rises with position (peaks at orig_idx 5-7) and so is concentrated near the end of the input (to_go 0-2) in long sequences. Token-selective: the current input is mostly h (strongest, 24% of mass, top activations are nearly all h), then 0, y, f, r, 1, g, x. Prefix modulates it: firing is more likely and stronger when earlier inputs include w/k/t/v (first_tok w is 2.8x), and weaker on repeated tokens (in_first=0 is 0.3x). It does not depend on the copy target. Predicate gets dev F1 0.62 with mass recall 0.85. Misses are low-magnitude firings on other tokens, and false positives are the selected tokens without a supportive prefix, so the description is incomplete.
